Baseball Teams Make Player Transactions and Achieve Wins

The Atlanta Braves acquired an infielder from the Toronto Blue Jays shortly after the Blue Jays released the player. Separately, the Blue Jays' manager sent a message to Alec Bohm of the Philadelphia Phillies following a surprising move. In another development, player Brett Bateman expressed feeling at home with the Blue Jays soon after joining them. The Blue Jays also secured their third consecutive victory against the Boston Red Sox, boosting their playoff aspirations.
